Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You let the room grow quiet before putting the request into words they can hear.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Guile
Time
One minute per attempt.
Target / range / shape
One willing listener; one minute of conversation
Duration
Information and earned progress persist for the stated task; completed changes remain until circumstances alter them.
Equipment / acquisition
None.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Skill

Before rolling, agree with the DA on what you are trying to accomplish and what is at risk. The DA states how much progress completes the task and whether progress carries over between attempts. Add the progress shown by your result. If the action has no uncertain consequence, resolve it without a roll.

Weak
1 progress toward a plausible stated concession; learn one objection the listener openly raises.
Standard
2 progress; learn that objection and one stated condition that might address it.
Strong
3 progress, both details above, and a related concern the listener volunteers.

Source: design/cards/measured-appeal.md at bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809.
